sectors.title: Sector knowledge and a systems view.
sectors.lead: Our practice is organized around sectors where experience, networks and delivery capability come together. In each one, our services run from early-stage studies through to project management.

items.title: Industrial and Corporate
items.label: 01 / Sector
items.description: Services for industrial, commercial and service companies in their growth, performance improvement and investment processes. Capabilities in commercial strategy, economic management, organization, engineering and project delivery, integrated according to the needs of the business.

services.title: Process and facility assessment and engineering
paragraphs: Assessment of production, logistics and corporate operations and assets to improve capacity, productivity and reliability. Redesign of workflows, modernization, expansions and relocations, with feasibility studies, architecture and engineering solutions and investment estimates.

services.title: Organizational design, leadership and training
paragraphs: Structures, responsibilities and management models suited to each company’s needs. Development of management teams, coordination across areas, expense control and training programs linked to growth and changes in operations.

services.title: Commercial expansion and expense and cost optimization
paragraphs: Growth strategies, market development, sales channels and new business opportunities. Analysis of profitability, expense structure, operating costs, purchasing and procurement, with economic and commercial improvement plans that strengthen competitiveness and guide management and investment decisions.

services.title: Management of transformation and investment projects
paragraphs: Planning and leadership of modernization, expansion and business change initiatives. Budgets, schedules, contracting, team coordination and monitoring of execution, with attention to meeting objectives, operational continuity and expected results.

items.title: Urban and Real Estate Development
items.label: 02 / Sector
items.description: Services for private, public and mixed developments involving land, buildings and development areas that require the integration of urban planning, technical and economic criteria. Studies, planning, projects and investment structures to advance viable initiatives and coordinate their participants.

services.title: Urban and real estate feasibility studies
paragraphs: Assessment of assets and opportunities based on their territorial context, regulatory framework, demand and economic conditions. Alternative uses and development potential, commercial scenarios and investment estimates to support development decisions.

services.title: Master plans, architecture and engineering
paragraphs: Definition of uses, site layouts, phasing and infrastructure for sites, urban complexes and real estate developments. Development of spatial proposals and technical solutions, coordinating disciplines with levels of design suited to each project.

services.title: Legal and financial structuring of developments
paragraphs: Participation and investment models to bring together landowners, developers, operators and funders. Economic evaluation, organization of contributions and returns, corporate instruments and contractual agreements that make each initiative viable.

services.title: Real estate project management
paragraphs: Organization and coordination of developments from definition through execution. Management of technical teams, budgets, timelines, procurement and contracting, tracking milestones, risks and commitments between the parties.

items.title: Infrastructure and Transport
items.label: 03 / Sector
items.description: Studies and projects to improve connectivity, the operation of networks and the performance of logistics and transport systems. Planning, engineering, investment structuring and program management in public, private and inter-institutional settings.

services.title: Demand and mobility studies
paragraphs: Characterization of freight and passenger flows, operating patterns, connectivity needs and the evolution of markets and regions. Projections and scenarios to size services, identify constraints and guide investment.

services.title: Logistics planning and infrastructure engineering
paragraphs: Assessment of corridors, hubs, networks and operating systems, focusing on capacity, costs, times and reliability. Organizational and location alternatives, functional solutions, preliminary designs and technical documentation for their development.

services.title: Structuring of infrastructure investments and contracts
paragraphs: Analysis of economic viability, financing schemes, regulatory frameworks and allocation of responsibilities. Public-private participation models, tender documents and agreements to prepare projects and facilitate their execution.

services.title: Project and program management
paragraphs: Technical, institutional and contractual coordination of investments of different scales. Organization of teams, schedules, budgets and procurement processes; physical and financial monitoring, interface management and progress control.

specialties.title: Cross-cutting capabilities.
specialties.lead: Four specialties to structure, position and manage complex projects and processes, combined to fit each engagement.

items.title: Strategy
items.label: 01 / Cross-cutting capability
items.description: Information, criteria and alternatives for growth, investment and transformation decisions. Applied to companies, regions, economic sectors and development programs.

services.title: Market and demand studies
paragraphs: Analysis of sectors, competitors, customers and users, with estimates of size, trends and commercial potential. Quantitative and qualitative research to identify opportunities and support projects, investments and policies.

services.title: Assessments and feasibility studies
paragraphs: Comprehensive evaluation of situations and development alternatives. Technical, operational, commercial, institutional and economic viability, identifying constraints, risks and requirements to move forward.

services.title: Business models and investment strategies
paragraphs: Definition of value propositions, revenue models, cost structures and ways of operating. Comparison of scenarios to guide new activities, expansion, diversification and capital decisions.

services.title: Strategic and development plans
paragraphs: Objectives, priorities, initiatives and implementation sequences for organizations, production chains and regions. Growth, transformation and investment programs with resources, responsibilities and monitoring criteria.

items.title: Culture, Leadership and Organization
items.label: 02 / Cross-cutting capability
items.description: Leadership, coordination and operational capabilities to support the performance and evolution of organizations. Integration of organizational, human and technical approaches.

services.title: Organizational assessment and design
paragraphs: Analysis of structures, responsibilities, working relationships and decision-making. Configuration of management models, coordination mechanisms and indicators suited to the strategy and scale of each institution.

services.title: Process engineering and improvement
paragraphs: Evaluation of operational and administrative workflows to increase productivity, quality and reliability. Redesign of tasks, interfaces, resources and information systems, with implementation and monitoring criteria.

services.title: Education and training programs
paragraphs: Development of technical, leadership and management skills based on specific needs. Learning paths, content, learning formats and mechanisms to verify their application on the job.

services.title: Leadership development and organizational transformation
paragraphs: Strengthening of management teams, leadership practices and collaboration across areas. Support for cultural and management change, with attention to the adoption of new responsibilities and ways of working.

items.title: Project Design and Management
items.label: 03 / Cross-cutting capability
items.description: Technical and management capabilities throughout the investment cycle, from the definition of an initiative to its contracting, implementation and control.

services.title: Project formulation and appraisal
paragraphs: Definition of objectives, needs, scope and alternative solutions. Preliminary studies, sizing, cost estimates, risk analysis and phase planning to prepare investment decisions.

services.title: Architecture, urban planning and master plans
paragraphs: Proposals for spatial organization, uses, site layout and development phases. Preliminary designs and design documentation for buildings, complexes, large sites and urban areas, coordinating the disciplines involved.

services.title: Technical studies and engineering
paragraphs: Development of design criteria, functional analyses and conceptual, basic or detailed solutions depending on the stage of development. Specifications, budgets and interdisciplinary coordination for their evaluation and execution.

services.title: Technical documentation and procurement processes
paragraphs: Preparation of terms of reference, tender documents, specifications and budgets. Organization of tenders and competitions, support with bidder queries and evaluation of offers for purchases, works and professional services.

services.title: Project management and control
paragraphs: Direction and monitoring of scope, time, cost, quality and risk. Coordination of teams and contractors, interface management and progress documentation to support decisions during execution.

items.title: Legal and Financial Structuring
items.label: 04 / Cross-cutting capability
items.description: Economic, corporate and contractual instruments to organize investments, allocate responsibilities and make projects with multiple participants viable.

services.title: Economic and financial modeling and evaluation
paragraphs: Projections of revenues, expenditures, investment and financing; cash flows, return indicators and sensitivity analysis. Comparison of alternatives and risks to support decisions and negotiations.

services.title: Legal structuring of projects and investments
paragraphs: Design of vehicles, participation schemes and the allocation of rights, obligations and contingencies. Consideration of the regulatory frameworks and institutional conditions of each initiative.

services.title: Contracts and negotiation processes
paragraphs: Preparation and review of instruments for investments, services, developments and construction works. Commercial terms, commitments, guarantees and mechanisms for resolving disputes between the parties.

services.title: Financial structuring and participation models
paragraphs: Equity, debt and hybrid alternatives, including public-private partnership arrangements. Organization of contributions, returns and agreements among owners, investors, operators and funding institutions.

about.title: Experience in real-world settings.
paragraphs: We work with public agencies, companies and development stakeholders on infrastructure, production, logistics and regional projects, bringing an integrated view and a deep understanding of local conditions.

GAPS is a professional services firm focused on developing projects, organizations and regions. We bring strategy, management and structuring together to turn opportunities into viable initiatives with clear direction.
about.callout: Experience in the public sector, public-private partnerships and a deep knowledge of Argentina’s emerging production corridors: agriculture, mining and energy.
